XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Activation of recovery mode, jerking while driving
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | WARNING LIGHT | FAULTS | MIL | MISFIRE | P0300 | SENSOR | RPM | STALL | PROTECTION | P0301 | P0304 |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Engine speed sensor

  • Fault: The car exhibits jerking and enters recovery mode. After switching the engine off and on again, the car returns to normal operation. The fault occurs intermittently.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P0300 (Missed ignition in cylinders)
    • P0301 (Missed ignition in cylinder 1)
    • P0304 (Misfire in cylinder 4)
  • Cause: RPM sensor malfunction

• Action: Replace the rev sensor and reset the self-adaptive parameters

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Initially, the spark plugs, cables and coils were checked, but no faults were found. Replacing the rev sensor solved the problem permanently.
